articles.summary: The Department of Transportation studied accident reports over a 10-year period and found 94 percent of public grade crossing accidents were caused by risky driver behavior, such as driving around activated automatic gates.
articles.title: Slow Down, Drive Safely in Winter Weather

articles.title: GiveMeTap and Virgin Money: What corporations and social enterprises can learn from one another
